name: BinaryProtocol
desc:
Low-level binary encode/decode. Kept in the same file to avoid a circular
import at the top level; see BinaryProtocol below.

name: decode
desc: Decode wire bytes to a packet.

name: encode
desc: Encode a packet to its wire bytes.

name: BitchatPacket
desc: Port of BitchatPacket.swift. The in-memory packet model.

desc: Canonical bytes used for signing (port of toBinaryDataForSigning).

name: CompressionUtil
desc: zlib compression/decompression for packet payloads.

name: compress
desc: Compress with zlib. Returns null if not beneficial or if it doesn't shrink.

name: decompress
desc:
Decompress zlib compressed expecting exactly originalSize bytes.
Returns null if decompression fails OR the size does not match.

name: shouldCompress
desc: Whether compressing data is worthwhile (mirrors native shouldCompress).

name: MeshIdentity
desc: Local mesh identity for the BitChat protocol.

name: generate
desc: Generate a fresh identity.

name: noisePrivateKey
desc:
X25519 key used as the Noise static identity. Its public key drives the
peer/sender ID derivation.

name: senderId
desc: 8 raw bytes. This is what goes in BitchatPacket.senderId.

name: signPacket
desc: Sign a packet and return a copy carrying the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

name: signingPrivateKey
desc: Ed25519 key used to sign/verify packets.

name: verifyPacket
desc: Verify a packet's signature against the given Ed25519 public key.
